entities.name: Lorelei Garensun
entities.description: Daughter of Hanweir's mayor who beheaded her beloved Pitre to stop him becoming a vampire, then joined the church.

entities.name: Jurgen Garensun
entities.description: Mayor of Hanweir and Lorelei's father.

entities.name: Pitre
entities.description: Lorelei's beloved who hunted a real vampire, failed and was beheaded by her.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: Town on Innistrad that met its fate as a writhing monstrosity.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel to whom Lorelei dedicated her life.

events.summary: Pitre returns wounded and near death from hunting a vampire; Lorelei beheads him to stop him turning.
Lorelei joins the church to dedicate her life to Avacyn, leaving her father to face the curse.
events.quote: she decided to join the church and dedicate her life to Avacyn

relations.quote: Lorelei Garensun was the daughter of Jurgen Garensun

relations.note: She beheaded him to prevent his turning.
She showed deep loyalty and love for him.
relations.quote: she showed deep loyalty and love for Pitre
